About

Beyond Cleaning.
Environmental Optimisation.

AIRVA+ exists to transform the environments in which people train, recover, and perform. We go beyond surface-level hygiene to engineer the complete atmosphere of a high-performance facility — because the environment itself is part of the result.

We partner with premium fitness and wellness operators across Australia to raise the standard of every space they create.

Hygiene

Clinical-grade product systems that eliminate pathogen risk at every touchpoint in your facility.

Air Quality

Targeted odour management and air purification solutions for training environments that demand fresh, clean air.

Wellness

A holistic approach that supports member wellbeing, retention, and the overall perception of your brand.

Facility Standards

Ongoing supply and guidance to keep your facility consistently performing at the level your members expect.

Member Experience

Every detail of the environment shapes the experience. We help you make it exceptional at every visit.

Professional Standards

Products and protocols aligned with professional-grade requirements across fitness and wellness industries.

Services

What We Provide

End-to-end environmental optimisation — products, strategy, and ongoing supply.

Premium Hygiene Products

A complete catalogue of facility-grade hygiene products, formulated specifically for high-traffic fitness and wellness environments.

Environment Optimisation

Strategic assessment and product recommendations to optimise every zone of your facility — from the entrance to the equipment floor.

Odour Management

Bespoke odour elimination programs that diagnose source issues and deploy enzymatic solutions for lasting results — not temporary fragrance cover-ups.

Air Quality Support

Guidance and product supply to improve and maintain indoor air quality, with options across passive filtration and active purification systems.

Facility Care Recommendations

Expert consultation on facility hygiene protocols, product scheduling, and usage guidelines tailored to your team and your operational hours.

Ongoing Product Supply

Reliable, scheduled supply of all products across your AIRVA+ system — ensuring your facility is never caught short, no matter the volume or frequency.
